description: The Modelica Buildings Library is a free, open-source library of dynamic simulation models for building and district energy and control systems. It contains models of HVAC systems, thermal and electrical storage, controls including a reference implementation of ASHRAE Standard 231P, heat transfer in rooms either natively or coupled at run time to EnergyPlus (Spawn of EnergyPlus), multizone airflow and contaminant transport, single-zone CFD, and two- and three-phase electrical systems, plus templates for district energy and data-centre cooling. Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory develops it with DOE funding to support design and operation of energy systems, controls verification and export of digital twins for fault detection and diagnostics. Coverage is generic; time resolution is continuous with variable-step solvers. It is written in Modelica and runs in Modelica simulation tools; version 13.0.0 was tagged in May 2026. Licence: a BSD-style licence from LBNL, free of charge. Caveat: it needs a Modelica simulation environment and Modelica skills, and not every model runs in every tool. Simulation uses are system sizing and capacity planning, control optimisation, district heating network flow and building digital twins. Related records: Modelica IBPSA Library (its core), AixLib, IDEAS and BuildingSystems (sister libraries), EnergyPlus and OpenModelica.
